title: Race timing desk
problem: A timing volunteer needs to explain why one pilot gained a lap when two gate detections arrived close together.

stack.purpose: Process an ordered fixture deterministically using integer milliseconds.
Store heat configuration, raw crossings and append-only rulings.
Expose the lap ledger and provisional standings locally.
Compare standings against a hand-scored fixture.

aws_extension.purpose: Optionally archive sanitized heat exports for later comparison.
Optionally recompute a result digest when an export is archived.

certifications.evidence: Demonstrate equal digests after duplicate deliveries in a local handler test.
Publish a hand-scored heat and a discrepancy report.

labs.title: Score a heat by hand
labs.task: Record two pilots and six crossings with an expected lap order.
labs.acceptance: Each expected lap links to a crossing ID.
labs.break_fix: Shuffle input rows and explain the expected order.

labs.title: Replay crossings
labs.task: Implement the pure scorer with explicit duplicate rules.
labs.acceptance: Two runs produce identical lap rows.
labs.break_fix: Duplicate one event and verify its effect is zero.

labs.title: Review a correction
labs.task: Validate marshal rulings and record their source locally.
labs.acceptance: The original event survives an exclusion.
labs.break_fix: Reference an unknown event and verify rejection.

labs.title: Archive a result
labs.task: Sketch an optional S3 event adapter and invoke its handler locally.
labs.acceptance: Repeated delivery yields the same digest.
labs.break_fix: Pass a missing heat ID and report a validation error.
labs.teardown: Delete local archives and temp files.

labs.title: Recover the standings
labs.task: Rebuild the view from a raw ledger and its rulings.
labs.break_fix: Remove the derived table before reprocessing.
